title: Coventry and Warwickshire heritage evaluation questions
description: One hundred beginner-readable questions that test place, designation, risk, time, people, source-backed associations, tolerant search, provenance, YAML-LD, fixture isolation and publication boundaries against the Coventry and Warwickshire heritage exemplar.

checks: the query returns the expected source-backed records or a meaningful bounded empty state
aliases, identifiers and declared one-edit misspellings lead to explainable results
the visible result count remains consistent across filters and views
the selected record explains designation, grade, place, time and risk fields without inventing missing values
graph, timeline and map presentations remain projections of the same result set
official rich pages and frozen machine-readable evidence are distinguishable
search, facets, views, records and disclosures are keyboard reachable and named
result and loading changes have perceivable status text
labels, controls and selected-record evidence remain readable at the tested viewport
language is plain, task-focused and explicit about evidence and limitations
source, licence, observation time and derivation are visible where relevant
the evaluation and synthetic supplement cannot be mistaken for a legal or assured heritage register
